profile.positioning:
As a Principal at NovaPoint Ventures, I focus on identifying and investing in high-growth, early-stage technology companies, primarily within the SaaS and Fintech sectors. My investment thesis centers on businesses demonstrating clear product-market fit, scalable business models, and strong founding teams. Having previously experienced the challenges and rewards of building a company from the ground up – as co-founder and former CTO of 'MarketSpark,' a marketing automation platform acquired by HubSpot in 2019 – I bring a unique, operator-focused perspective to the investment process. I don’t just analyze spreadsheets; I understand the grit required to navigate the complexities of early-stage growth. 

I’m deeply interested in the transformative potential of Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning across various industries, and actively seek out companies leveraging these technologies to solve significant problems. My current portfolio includes companies in areas like embedded finance, vertical SaaS for underserved markets, and AI-powered developer tools. I believe the next wave of innovation will be driven by companies that can seamlessly integrate AI into existing workflows, creating substantial value for both businesses and end-users. 

I’m a strong believer in collaborative investing and am always open to exploring syndication opportunities with other leading venture firms. I view myself as a partner to founders, providing not only capital but also strategic guidance, operational support, and access to a valuable network of industry experts. Ultimately, my goal is to help build enduring companies that positively impact the world.

profile.introPreferences:
